description: F-3 is replaced by f1, which cites only docs/guide.md; C-1 becomes F-2 and f1, both resting on the guide, so it is withdrawn ("sources_not_distinct"). C-3 becomes f1, F-4 and F-6 and passes, because F-4 does not cite the guide.
section: IMPL §3.3.3 (SUP-005 again on a call-1 conflict changed by a replacement), §3.2.3

findings.statement: The guide names the shared client as the way to make HTTP calls.

citations.quote: HTTP calls go through the shared client in src/client.ts.

revisions.reason: The direct call is a documented exception.
